info.name: METT-DataPortal
info.description:
METT Data Portal REST API.

**Auth:** collection-level Bearer `{{bearer-token-current}}` (set in the Postman environment).

**Host:** `{{mett-current}}` from the environment (local / dev / prod).

**Fixtures:** isolate names, locus tags, species acronyms, and release tokens are collection variables. Change them once at collection scope instead of editing individual requests.

Run **CoreAPIs / Releases / List-Releases** first when exercising X-METT-Release scenarios; it stores `resolved_release_version`.
